headline: Türkiye Central Bank Cuts Benchmark Rate to 36% Despite Inflation Risks
summary: The Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye lowered its benchmark policy interest rate to 36% along with cuts to overnight rates, stating future adjustments will hinge on meeting-by-meeting inflation projections.
why: The CBRT's monetary policy decisions directly steer the Turkish lira, domestic credit expansion, and foreign institutional capital flows.

entities.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey

impacts.name: Turkish Lira
impacts.why: Monetary loosening amid persistent inflation risks can weigh on currency stability unless real interest rate margins remain supportive.

why_moved: The Turkish central bank surprised markets with a benchmark rate reduction to 36% and lowered overnight lending rates.
